Enterprise Cloud Migration and Managed Services

The U.S. Army Contracting Command – Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG) intends to issue a solicitation for enterprise cloud migration, operations and managed services in support of DEVCOM.

  • Anticipated NAICS: 541512
  • Set-aside: Total Small Business
  • Responses due 20 October 2026 at 2:00 PM ET

See the attached Performance Work Statement. Questions must be submitted by email.
